name: Ringetsu Wakaoku-sama ~Kouman Fujin no Kairaku Shinryou~
original_name: 臨月若奥様～高慢夫人の快楽診療～
source:
"Where is this place? If anyone’s here, come out!"

Today, a woman was brought to my clinic.
Her name is Sae Yamaguchi, the wife of a CEO at a major corporation.
Sae, wielding the power of her status as the CEO’s wife, acts with complete disregard for others, doing whatever she pleases.
Now that she’s pregnant, it’s clear she’ll use the child as a shield to further flaunt her authority.

Unable to stand his wife’s behavior, her husband—a man I owe a great deal to—asked me to guide her into becoming a proper, virtuous wife and mother.
He even said I could do whatever it takes to make it happen.

However, Sae, raised as the daughter of a former noble family, has an incredibly high pride.
Getting her to follow my guidance has been anything but easy.

Will I be able to guide her properly…?

[Translated from [url=http://masterup.net/gokufero/product/ringetsu/index.html]the official website[/url]]
